@realm:     Mentalism
@name:      Medical Law
@category:  Training Package
#
# Format: <level> | <spell_name> | <area_effect> | <duration> | <range> | <type>
# A trailing '*' on the name marks a Concentration / continuing-effect spell.
#
 1 | Detect Disease | 1 target | - | 10' | P
 2 | Detect Poison | 1 target | - | 10' | P
 3 | Detect Physical Malady | 1 target | - | 10' | P
 4 | Incision | 1 target | 10 min/lvl | touch | U
 5 | Close Wound | 1 target | P | touch | U
 6 | Clean Wound | 1 target | - | 10' | P
 7 | Detect Mental Malady | 1 target | P | 10' | U
 8 | Suppress Disease | 1 target | 1 hr/lvl | 10' | U
 9 | Set Bones | 1 target | P | touch | U
10 | Suppress Poison | 1 target | 1 hr/lvl | 10' | U
11 | Disease Analysis | 1 target | - | 10' | I
12 | Poison Analysis | 1 target | - | 10' | I
13 | Remove Infection | 1 target | P | touch | U
14 | Analyze Physical Malady | 1 target | - | 10' | I
15 | Resuscitation | 1 target | P | touch | U
16 | Analyze Mental Malady | 1 target | - | 10' | I
17 | Local Anesthesia | 1 target | 10 min/lvl | touch | Fm
18 | Preserve Body | 1 target | 1 day/lvl | touch | U
20 | Biovoyance | 1 target | - | touch | I
25 | Phase Surgery | 1 target | 10 min/lvl | (C)touch | U
30 | General Anesthesia | 1 target | 10 min/lvl | touch | Fm
50 | Resuscitation True | 1 target | P | touch | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster learns if any illness or disease is effecting the target. Caster also
learns the number of illnesses/ diseases, but not their nature.
@@ 2
Caster learns if any poison is effecting the target. Caster also learns the
number of toxins, but not their nature.
@@ 3
Caster learns if any physical malady (i.e., broken bone, sprains,
tendon/muscle damage, internal bleeding etc. but not diseases or poisons) is
effecting the target. Caster also learns the number of illnesses/diseases and
a general location of each malady.
@@ 4
Creates clean incision into living material a predetermined length and depth.
The incision will not bleed for the duration of the spell.
@@ 5
Closes any one wound (leaving only a small scar). In the case of a normal
wound (i.e., not caused by an Incision), the binding should be treated as a
sewn wound (which may reopen under stress).
@@ 6
Removes any foreign material from an open wound.
@@ 7
Caster learns if any mental illness or disease is affecting the target. Caster
also learns the number of such problems, but not their nature.
@@ 8
Stops infection/spread of one disease in the target. No further damage will
occur in uninfected areas of the body for the duration of this spell. Damage
already sustained is not cured. The disease must be specified at time of
casting. This spell can be used preemptively to prevent the infection of a
healthy person (this results in any RRs versus the specified disease being
modifiedy by +50).
@@ 9
Allows the caster to set any bone or joint (simple or compound fracture, or
shatters) in the correct position for natural healing. Appropriate support
will be necessary to ensure the bone or joint stays in place until healing is
well underway.
@@ 10
Stabilises one poison in the system of the target. No further damage will
occur for the duration of this spell. Damage already sustained is not cured.
The poison must be specified at time of casting. This spell can be used
preemptively to prevent the infection of a healthy person (this results in any
RRs versus the specified poison being modifiedy by +50).
@@ 11
Caster acquires complete knowledge of one diesase affecting the target
including name, type, and expected effect(s) of the disease, and cure and
necessary treatment required. The spell does not give the caster the skill,
the power or the materials to effect the cure.
@@ 12
Caster acquires complete knowledge of one poison effecting the target
including name, type, and expected effect(s) of the poison, and cure and
necessary treatment required. The spell does not give the caster the skill,
the power or the materials to effect the cure.
@@ 13
Allows a caster to completely clean one wound of any type of natural
infection. The spell will not keep an open wound clean and it will be
necessary to remove the material causing the infection.
@@ 14
Caster acquires complete knowledge of one physical malady affecting the target
including name, type, exact location and expected effect(s) of the malady, and
cure and necessary treatment required. The spell does not give the caster the
skill, the power, the tools or the materials to effect the cure.
@@ 15
The caster can revive the target after any sudden lapse in bodily functions
(due to drowning, heart attack, shock, etc.), but the bodily functions cannot
have lapsed for more than 1 round per level of the caster. This spell will
restore bodily functions to normal heart rate, breathing, etc. Body must have
proper attention and the cause of the lapse must be removed to prevent a
recurrence.
@@ 16
Caster acquires complete knowledge of one mental problem affecting the target
including name, type, and expected effect(s) of the malady, and cure and
necessary treatment required. The spell does not give the caster the skill,
the power or the materials to effect the cure.
@@ 17
Completely numbs part or all of a target’s body for surgical procedures for
the duration of the spell. The target is not rendered unconscious.
@@ 18
Will perfectly preserve a body or portion thereof (even if the portion is
separated from a living host). The tissue is preserved in exactly the same
condition it was in at time of casting.
@@ 20
Gives the caster a mental “still picture” of the interior of a target’s body,
which may be of the entire body or a specific region. If the picture is of the
entire body, it will reveal broken bones, massive trauma etc, while if it is
of a specific bodily part, it may show detail at the level of blocked blood
vessels, damaged muscles etc.
@@ 25
Caster causes the target to become transparent and insubstantial, allowing the
caster to imbed his hands inside the target, without causing any harm, and
perform minor surgery or remove alien objects (caster can concentrate to make
any portion of the target substantial enough to perform the surgery or
procedure). Caster must still use any required tools or spells. The spell only
affects living tissue.
@@ 30
As Local Anesthesia, except the target is rendered deeply unconscious for the
duration.
@@ 50
As Resuscitation, except the lapse can be up to 1 minute per level of the
caster.
